scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate -w apps/server && npm run db:migrate -w apps/server && npm run db:seed -w apps/server
